text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was lookin' my way and<n>talkin' about
how fast I was!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! So, what didja think?!
choice_data_list: I know you can be even more evil!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Neeheehee! That's right! Bow down<n>before me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
At last, the world has realized how<n>amazingly evil I
am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
MWAHAHAHA! I'mma win the next<n>one, too! Then
no one'll ever take<n>their eyes off of me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I just won, didn't I?! What's<n>badder than
that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You know what your problem is? You<n>think you're
smart is what! Now say<n>your prayers!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'mma take a chomp right outta ya!
